species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 38°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 24–116 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
